slices.title: Specification
slices.summary: The canonical repository specification, its machine-readable manifests, a non-runtime validator and that validator's CI wiring. No runtime source, no schema, no migration.

slices.title: Durable core
slices.schema_note: PR-A defines v1; it has no schema predecessor.
slices.summary: Database, migration runner with checksums and integrity verification, append-only history, the single injected clock.

slices.title: State machine
slices.summary: Closed state vocabulary, explicit transition table, target resolution from persisted data, recovery shape.

slices.title: Principals and leases
slices.summary: Principal registry and roles, claims with expiry and monotonic fencing, the singleton reviewer subject, reconciliation claims distinct from execution claims.

slices.title: Evidence and verdicts
slices.summary: Immutable observations, content digests, snapshot computation, findings and append-only resolution events, source-role policy, round accounting.

slices.title: Effect journal
slices.schema_note: v3 is produced by PR-D, which is therefore PR-E's schema predecessor as well as its merge predecessor.
slices.summary: Journal states, durable execution claims, probe-only reconciliation, redemption keys, registrability of action kinds.

slices.title: Authorization envelope
slices.summary: Issuance, storage and redemption of the 25-field envelope; outcomes; waits; use ordinals; the one transaction that consumes a use and records an intent.

slices.title: Report ingestion
slices.summary: Transport identity, replay protection, contract validation, atomic authorisation and application of an accepted report.

slices.title: Scheduler
slices.summary: Dependency graph, lane limits, resource capacity, gate monotonicity, dispatch in one transaction, reconciliation sweeps.

slices.title: Operator surface
slices.summary: CLI, read-only project adapter, the demo scenario, and the documentation-conformance check.
